Re-posting from the delegates room:

Hey, we're trying to gather some temperature regarding an option name, for the dynamic import form of import { ... } as ns from "x" in the export defer proposal.

I have a google form with a few options, I'd appreciate if y'all could select how you feel about them. Consider this like an async temperature check :) It's not a vote, but it will help us come with a recommendation at the next meeting.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfCURrVKg0R8e6AwO0M2eLRom2xi5sFCKB77l5Wlb0j7TlMEQ/viewform
